cases.title: Pigeonhole principle
cases.summary: Three pigeons require at least one hole each. Pairwise exclusions allow at most two occupied places.
cases.input:
; Pigeonhole Principle PHP(3, 2): 3 pigeons into 2 holes (UNSAT)
(set-logic QF_UF)

(declare-const p1_h1 Bool)
(declare-const p1_h2 Bool)
(declare-const p2_h1 Bool)
(declare-const p2_h2 Bool)
(declare-const p3_h1 Bool)
(declare-const p3_h2 Bool)

; Every pigeon must be in at least one hole
(assert (or p1_h1 p1_h2))
(assert (or p2_h1 p2_h2))
(assert (or p3_h1 p3_h2))

; No two pigeons can be in hole 1
(assert (not (and p1_h1 p2_h1)))
(assert (not (and p1_h1 p3_h1)))
(assert (not (and p2_h1 p3_h1)))

; No two pigeons can be in hole 2
(assert (not (and p1_h2 p2_h2)))
(assert (not (and p1_h2 p3_h2)))
(assert (not (and p2_h2 p3_h2)))

(check-sat)
(exit)

cases.title: Linear real infeasibility
cases.summary: The lower bounds imply x + y ≥ 2.5. The upper bound is 2.0.
cases.input:
; Linear Real Arithmetic Simplex Infeasibility
(set-logic QF_LRA)

(declare-const x Real)
(declare-const y Real)

; Convex polytope constraints
(assert (<= (+ x y) 2.0))
(assert (>= x 1.5))
(assert (>= y 1.0))

; Infeasible: x + y >= 2.5 > 2.0
(check-sat)
(exit)

cases.title: GCD verification condition
cases.summary: Earlier Axiom builds returned SAT on this fixture. The repaired integer comparison uses a unit gap, and both solvers now return UNSAT.
cases.input:
; Euclidean GCD Verification Condition in SMT-LIB 2.6
(set-logic QF_LIA)

(declare-const a Int)
(declare-const b Int)
(declare-const x Int)
(declare-const y Int)

; Precondition: a > 0 and b > 0
(assert (> a 0))
(assert (> b 0))

; Invariance: x > 0 and y > 0
(assert (> x 0))
(assert (> y 0))

; While loop condition: x != y
(assert (not (= x y)))

; Transition: if x > y then x' = x - y, y' = y
(declare-const x_prime Int)
(declare-const y_prime Int)

(assert (= x_prime (- x y)))
(assert (= y_prime y))
(assert (> x y))

; Verification condition: post invariant x' > 0 and y' > 0
(assert (not (and (> x_prime 0) (> y_prime 0))))

(check-sat)
(exit)
